title: Independent paired Gaussian mixtures
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and $u\in\mathbb R$. If $X_1,X_2,Y_1,Y_2$ are independent standard Gaussian vectors in $\mathbb R^n$, then $(\cos u\,X_1+\sin u\,Y_1,\cos u\,X_2+\sin u\,Y_2)$ has the product of two standard Gaussian laws on $\mathbb R^n$.
replaced: Let $\gamma_n$ be standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$. For any real $u$, if $X_1,X_2,Y_1,Y_2$ are independent with law $\gamma_n$, then $(\cos u\,X_1+\sin u\,Y_1,\cos u\,X_2+\sin u\,Y_2)$ has law $\gamma_n\otimes\gamma_n$.
